inference_dir.description: Root used by inference.output.mode=default. Use default to resolve to the project inference root, or provide an explicit local path.
inference_dir.title: Inference Dir

LocalInferenceOutputConfig.description: User-specific defaults controlling where and what `lisai apply` saves.

mode.description: Default output placement for `lisai apply`: default uses inference_dir, in_place writes directly with the input data, folder_inside creates a dedicated folder inside the source folder, and folder_outside creates a dedicated folder beside the source folder.
mode.title: Mode

save_input_mode.description: Default policy for saving apply inputs: always saves them, never omits them, and if_not_in_place saves them unless predictions are written directly with the source data.
save_input_mode.title: Save Input Mode
